text: {"features":[{"name":"Security motivation","description":"How convincingly the letter shows genuine desire to work in preventative security engineering.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Treats the role mainly as a software job and gives little indication of why security work itself matters."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States interest in security impact but in broad, interchangeable terms that could fit many roles."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explains a clear reason for wanting security work, usually tied to prevention, hardening, or resilience."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Frames security engineering as a meaningful personal direction and gives a thoughtful rationale for that choice."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes preventative security feel like a central professional motivation, using vivid framing that strongly reinforces fit."}]},{"name":"Automation insight","description":"How well the letter articulates the leverage of automating security processes such as triage or variant analysis.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Says little or nothing about how automation changes security work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions automation or efficiency only in passing, without linking it to concrete security processes."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explains one concrete security-automation use case, such as triage, routing, or reducing manual workload."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear understanding of security automation as a systems problem that scales expert attention across the lifecycle."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Articulates a nuanced force-multiplier view of security automation, explicitly discussing ideas like scaling scarce judgment, variant analysis, or bounded agent behavior."}]},{"name":"Platform orientation","description":"How strongly the letter shows motivation for foundational work whose impact compounds across many teams or products.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not connect interest in the role to broad organizational impact."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Nods to large scale but without showing why platform-wide leverage matters personally."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly states interest in central systems or foundational infrastructure that help many teams."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Links past work or preferred working style to the multiplier effect of platform teams."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes organization-wide leverage a major theme of the letter and convincingly shows it as a longstanding career preference."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement","description":"How well the letter presents security as helping developers adopt secure defaults through tooling rather than after-the-fact policing.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not discuss helping developers or making security practices easier to follow."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Briefly mentions supporting others without framing security as a workflow or defaults problem."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States that secure development should be easier or more routine for engineers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains security as embedded tooling, better defaults, or reduced friction for developer teams."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong empathy for developer behavior and makes a compelling case that good security engineering works by shaping defaults, not policing after the fact."}]},{"name":"Collaboration orientation","description":"How well the letter signals readiness to work closely with security specialists and serve internal users of the tooling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no meaningful indication of how the applicant works with security specialists or internal users."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Implies general teamwork but does not connect it to this role's cross-functional nature."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions partnering with other engineers or building tools for others."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly emphasizes close partnership with security engineers or proximity to internal users as important to good results."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes cross-functional service a core theme, showing humility, learning orientation, and care for the people who depend on the tooling."}]},{"name":"Experience depth","description":"How much relevant professional software-engineering depth the letter conveys through years of experience and career progression.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Presents experience near the minimum bar for the role and little sense of progression."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows a modest amount of relevant experience beyond the minimum but limited depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Conveys solid mid-level relevant experience with several years of professional software work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Conveys substantial relevant experience or visible growth in responsibility over time."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Conveys deep, mature relevant experience at the upper end of the sample, with clear evidence of progression."}]},{"name":"Production ownership","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates hands-on responsibility for testing, maintaining, launching, or operating production services.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions production systems only briefly, with minimal evidence of end-to-end responsibility."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some hands-on production work but limited repetition or scope."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly describes testing, maintaining, or launching several production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows repeated ownership of multiple production services with operational or launch responsibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents extensive, repeated end-to-end ownership of many production services as a core part of the profile."}]},{"name":"Academic preparation","description":"How strong the letter's formal academic preparation is for a technically demanding software-security role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Lists only baseline bachelor's-level education as formal technical preparation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Lists a relevant bachelor's degree and uses it as a meaningful technical foundation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Lists a relevant master's degree."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Lists a relevant doctoral degree."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Lists a relevant doctoral degree and explicitly uses advanced study to signal unusual technical rigor."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"How convincingly the letter establishes depth with Go for the backend work central to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only as a basic qualification or one of several languages, with little role-relevant depth."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Says Go is a main language but gives little evidence of sustained professional use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Makes clear that Go has been used regularly in professional production work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows sustained Go use across multiple years or systems in role-relevant work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a long-term primary language and directly ties it to backend or infrastructure systems similar to this role."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"How convincingly the letter shows ability to use Python for tooling, automation, or AI-agent work in production settings.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or mentions it too vaguely to infer capability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python as a secondary skill without showing how it is used."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for scripts, tooling, analysis, or internal services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong Python use in production automation, services, or agent-related work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Python as a daily, production-grade language for automation or agents, with concrete detail about engineering practices or outputs."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"How well the letter demonstrates strong command of data structures and algorithms through relevant examples.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention data structures or algorithms at all."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic strength or problem-solving ability without a concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides one concrete example of improving a system through a better algorithm or data structure."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong practical fluency by redesigning a meaningful performance or correctness bottleneck."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes data structures and algorithms feel like a standout strength through a specific example that materially changed scale, speed, or tractability."}]},{"name":"Applied AI","description":"How well the letter demonstrates experience applying AI or LLMs in production systems relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention AI experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI interest, experimentation, or buzzwords without shipped production use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States experience shipping AI or LLM-backed features in production at a general level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes hands-on AI delivery with attention to reliability, evaluation, or safeguards."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows substantial applied AI experience in production and clearly explains how trustworthy behavior was engineered or assessed."}]},{"name":"Security assessment","description":"How well the letter shows ability to perform structured security assessments of systems or designs.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention doing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"References security review work vaguely, without clear methods or repeated practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States hands-on experience assessing the security of services or designs."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes concrete assessment methods such as threat modeling, code review, attack-surface analysis, or validation of fixes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents security assessment as a serious, repeated engineering practice and shows an explicit attacker-minded way of thinking."}]},{"name":"Triage automation","description":"How well the letter demonstrates direct experience automating intake, classification, deduplication, routing, or handling of vulnerability reports.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention vulnerability-handling automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Talks about security automation generally but not about vulnerability-report workflows."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building some automation for vulnerability intake or triage."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly explains automating key triage steps such as classification, deduplication, routing, or prioritization."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows vulnerability-handling automation as a major accomplishment with concrete process improvement or expert time returned to the team."}]},{"name":"Agentic architecture","description":"How well the letter demonstrates design of systems in which software agents act within explicit technical constraints.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention agents or agentic systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents without making the architecture or controls clear."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States experience building agentic tooling with Go and Python components."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains how agents and supporting services are separated, constrained, or supervised."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates strong agentic-systems judgment through detailed emphasis on bounded actions, clear contracts, permissions, or auditability."}]},{"name":"Security practice","description":"How much the letter shows ongoing security skill-building outside normal job duties through certifications, competitions, or similar practice.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no sign of security practice beyond ordinary job claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions light external security learning or a basic credential with little depth signal."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows one meaningful external signal such as Security+, OSCP, or regular CTF participation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong independent security investment through a demanding certification or consistently strong competition results."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows sustained, high-credibility security practice through multiple strong external signals or exceptionally strong results."}]},{"name":"Open-source impact","description":"How much the letter demonstrates contribution to or maintenance of open-source software relevant to engineering credibility.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of open-source involvement."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional bug fixes or patch submission with little detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows repeated contribution to open-source tools or dependencies."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial open-source responsibility, such as maintaining a project or widely used library."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows high-impact open-source leadership with external users and ongoing responsibility for reviews, releases, or roadmap."}]},{"name":"Project depth","description":"How much the letter uses self-initiated technical work outside the day job to signal engineering depth and curiosity.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention any personal project or self-initiated build work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions only a very small or generic side project with little technical challenge."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes a modest but complete personal project that shows follow-through."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a technically substantial personal project with meaningful systems or reliability complexity."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Uses a major self-directed build with demanding distributed-systems, storage, or failure-handling concerns to demonstrate unusual depth and persistence."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How much the letter supports claims with concrete examples, actions, numbers, or outcomes rather than generic assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad claims and adjectives with almost no concrete evidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few specifics but leaves most important claims unsupported."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports several claims with concrete examples or metrics."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Consistently backs claims with tangible examples, scope, or outcomes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is densely evidence-based, with multiple precise examples that let a reader infer skill rather than take it on faith."}]},{"name":"Coherence","description":"How easy the letter is to follow because of its structure, flow, and logical progression of ideas.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Feels disjointed, list-like, or hard to follow from one idea to the next."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a basic structure but uneven flow or abrupt transitions."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Is generally well organized and readable, with a sensible progression."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Flows smoothly across paragraphs and builds a clear cumulative case."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is exceptionally coherent, with each paragraph serving a clear purpose in a tightly connected argument."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"How polished the letter is at the sentence level in spelling, grammar, and typographical accuracy.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent errors that distract, undermine credibility, or obscure meaning."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has several noticeable errors that repeatedly interrupt reading."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has occasional errors but remains professional and easy to understand."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is clean and polished with only minor or rare slips."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is essentially error-free and reads as carefully proofread."}]},{"name":"Persuasive voice","description":"How compelling, memorable, and personally convincing the letter is as an argument for hiring the applicant.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as generic or interchangeable, with little individual perspective."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some personality but leaves only a mild impression."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Conveys a distinct professional point of view and a reasonably engaging tone."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses memorable framing or phrasing that materially strengthens the case for fit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers a highly memorable, distinctive voice that makes the overall case feel unusually convincing."}]}]}
